state_source: Concatenated same512 expert and512 old10M native-failure states from critic_followup.json
native_load: Exact native agent.load all6 checkpoint files including optimizer,scaler,normalizer. Networks wrapped in torch.compile backend=eager to preserve _orig_mod namespaces; get_mean_and_std also uses backend=eager. Initialization normalization occurred before load only.
frozen_load: Actual FrozenPolicy flash branch, cfg.use_compile=False; loads actor network_state_dict only, strips _orig_mod, .eval andrequires_gradFalse.
cpu_only_overrides: device/buffer_device CPU; small native2048 or frozen1 replay; helper decorators executed via original eager math. No Isaac/GPU/Inductor compiled kernels or network optimizer updates.
limits: CPU eager graph execution validates deserialization, explicit train/eval flags, layouts and sampling math. It does NOT prove native CUDA Inductor graphs/TF32/AMP/runtime graph caches produce identical actions.
Strided-versus-contiguous differences are recorded even when small. A long contact simulation can amplify roundoff; this audit does not prove small differences cannot affect rollout success.
All tests use identical offline states. They do not prove online training and frozen rollout visit identical states or have matching reset/startup/num_env protocols.
process_transition checks use n_step1, CPU copied arrays, and no optimizer update. Source code paths use explicit copies, but asynchronous CUDA behavior is not exercised.

Changing entropy alpha does not set collector noise multiplier: native uses1 when training,0 deterministic; FrozenPolicy native modeuses noise_multiplier1. Exact stochastic parity here holds despite alpha2e−5 vs.01.

code_inspection.explicit_bn: UnitBatchNorm.forward calls F.batch_norm(...training=training), and actor/block pass this explicit flag; actor sampling always requests training=False.
code_inspection.module_training: No dropout or self.training-dependent actor path found in FlashSAC network/layer code. .train/.eval flag toggling also tested empirically.
code_inspection.load_normalization: Network.load uses load_state_dict, optional optimizer/scheduler restore; no normalization or .train/.eval action inside load. Initialization normalization precedes checkpoint load; optimizer weight normalization is not run by inference.
code_inspection.training_transition_copy: train.py copies next_observations for replay before final_obs substitution, processes transition, then restores next_observation reference to post-reset observations for the next action.
code_inspection.buffer_copy: TorchUniformBuffer._to_tensor clones tensors or creates torch.tensor(array); n-step computations clone their working values.
code_inspection.normalizer: RewardNormalizer.update_reward_stats assigns new running tensors; normalize_rewards returns rewards / denominator, not in-place division.
